scoring.binary_case_score: one per case per ordinal capture
scoring.bf16_floor: each BF16 capture independently requires at least 5/6 binary scores in every category
scoring.case_point: arithmetic mean of its three ordinal binary scores
scoring.category_point: arithmetic mean of six case points
scoring.critical_regression: reject when AWQ category point minus BF16 category point is less than -0.16666666666666666

bootstrap.prng: random.Random(seed).randrange(6), category order lexical, replicate order ascending
bootstrap.unit: case ID cluster: retain all three ordinal BF16/AWQ pairs
bootstrap.sampling: six IDs with replacement independently per category
bootstrap.statistic: mean of 18 paired deltas per category, then equal-weight mean of six categories
bootstrap.quantile: sorted replicate values at index ceil(0.025*n)-1

loss.token_ids: returned prompt_token_ids must exactly equal stored model list; hash is SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON object {serialization,token_ids}
loss.first_token: the null first prompt_logprob is unscored but its token ID stays in equality/hash
loss.mean_nll: mean(-logprob) over every non-null aligned returned prompt_logprobs
loss.bf16_ceiling: 1.05 * max of three BF16 ordinal mean NLL values
loss.awq_rule: reject if any AWQ ordinal mean NLL exceeds its case ceiling
